deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for service=runtime-gateway environment=production (us-west-2) target=canary commit=9f3b2a7 tag=v2.3.0-rc4 image=runtime-gw:v2.3.0-rc4 configuration=pin-model:redwood-2.1-quant change_window=2025-11-05T18:00:00Z..22:00:00Z
alice: ✅ starting canary. which routes are in the canary pool?
deploy-bot: routes=\`/v1/generate,/v1/chat\` traffic_split=5% -> canary pods=3 autoscale=min 3 max 12
carol: noted model pinned to redwood-2.1-quant — thanks. that avoids floating model changes during rollout.
infra-oncall: monitoring hooks? will we get heap/gpu temp alerts into #eng-oncall?
monitoring-bot: Subscribed alerts: runtime-error-rate (>0.5%), p95-latency (>450ms), gpu-temp(>85C). Forwarding to #eng-oncall and oncall pager.
sara: quick sanity check — commit 9f3b2a7 includes kernel change, any DB migrations?
alice: no DB migrations. small runtime kernel reorder, should be safe. rolling canary now.
monitoring-bot: [00:02] metrics snapshot: error_rate=0.12% (baseline 0.10%), p95=410ms (baseline 395ms), token/s per pod stable.
carol: looks fine to me. no new 5xxs. recommend promoting to 30% after 10m if stable.
infra-oncall: promote to 30%? I can watch for the next 15m.
bob: +1 from me. remember to update release notes with the runtime image and pinned model.
deploy-bot: Promotion: canary -> 30% traffic. updated target pods=8. commit=9f3b2a7 tag=v2.3.0-rc4
monitoring-bot: [00:12] metrics snapshot: error_rate=0.14%, p95=420ms, no CPU/GPU OOMs detected. small latency blip during rollout but within SLO.
infra-oncall: still green on our dashboards. I'm okay to continue.
sara: doing quick smoke tests on /v1/generate and /v1/chat, responses look good.
carol: let's wait 10 more minutes then full promote if still green.
monitoring-bot: [00:22] metrics snapshot: error_rate=0.11%, p95=405ms, request success 99.88%. No regression alerts.
alice: proceeding to full rollout. locking version: runtime-gw:v2.3.0-rc4 pinned to commit 9f3b2a7 and model redwood-2.1-quant.
deploy-bot: Promotion: 30% -> 100% traffic. rollout complete. finish_time=1749551480 status=SUCCESS details=all-canary-promoted
bob: awesome. adding a short note to release notes: "runtime-gateway v2.3.0-rc4 (commit 9f3b2a7) — kernel reorder, pinned model redwood-2.1-quant, no DB migrations"
carol: thumbs: :tada: will monitor for the next hour. if error_rate >0.5% or p95 >450ms we rollback.
infra-oncall: rollback plan is ready -> command: \`kubectl -n prod set image deployment/runtime-gateway runtime-gw=runtime-gw:v2.2.9 --record\` and scaling back to previous replica counts.
alice: thanks everyone. I'll update the changelog and send a brief to product/legal about the model pin.
deploy-bot: Note: change_window still open until 2025-11-05T22:00:00Z. If rollback is triggered, please include thread_ts=1749551234 in incident report.
carol: closing thread after 1h of stable metrics unless someone objects.
alice: no objections. great work.
